shots.why: He is arriving and the weather is doing the work. A held figure with a slow trudge, everything else carried by drift.
The triumph pose is the joke's setup and it has to sit there long enough to become slightly embarrassing. Only the mist moves.
The double-take is the single performance beat in the film. It is the one place the character animates properly.
Deflation, then nothing. Sixteen seconds is a comic hold and the plan should say so rather than let the renderer infer it. The reveal has landed; anything energetic here steps on it.
